dialogues.jp:
「サイン、コサイン、タンジェント……って、
　あら？」
dialogues.en: (......I remember.)
dialogues.text: (......I remember.)

dialogues.jp:
数学の授業を受けていたはずが、何故か、気が
つけば外に居た。
dialogues.en: This is the room I saw in the dream.
dialogues.text: This is the room I saw in the dream.

dialogues.en:
This is the room where the young girl was sitting near the
window with a cat in her arms, looking down at the
street......
dialogues.text:
This is the room where the young girl was sitting near the
window with a cat in her arms, looking down at the
street......

dialogues.jp:
数学の催眠作用を考えれば、それも不思議じゃ
ないが……。
dialogues.en: All of a sudden, I notice there's someone standing.
dialogues.text: All of a sudden, I notice there's someone standing.

dialogues.jp: （しかし、ここ、どこ……？）
dialogues.en: It's Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text: It's Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
誰かの部屋だが、その主が誰かは分からない。
暗くて、どうやら時刻は夜らしい。
dialogues.en:
Her hair's down and looks different, but it's her. But more
importantly......
dialogues.text:
Her hair's down and looks different, but it's her. But more
importantly......

dialogues.jp:
けれど、どことなく見覚えがある。どこで見た
んだろう……？
dialogues.en: She's completely naked.
dialogues.text: She's completely naked.

dialogues.jp: （……そうか）
dialogues.en:
Her white well-proportioned naked body appears out of the
dark.
dialogues.text:
Her white well-proportioned naked body appears out of the
dark.

dialogues.jp: ここは、あの夢で見た部屋だ。
dialogues.en: It completely takes my breath away.
dialogues.text: It completely takes my breath away.

dialogues.jp:
一人の少女が窓際に座り、腕に猫を抱いて、道
を見下ろしていたあの部屋……。
dialogues.en:
But I don't feel erotic desire for her. It's just not like
that.
dialogues.text:
But I don't feel erotic desire for her. It's just not like
that.

dialogues.jp: ふと、人が立っているのに気づいた。
dialogues.en:
I can't feel vital energy in her. The expression on her face
and her body doesn't move a bit. I can't tell whether she's
breathing or not.
dialogues.text:
I can't feel vital energy in her. The expression on her face
and her body doesn't move a bit. I can't tell whether she's
breathing or not.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんだった。
dialogues.en: It's just standing there like a human.
dialogues.text: It's just standing there like a human.

dialogues.jp:
髪を下ろしているので印象が異なるが、間違い
なく彼女だ。
dialogues.en: And there's another girl lying down on the floor.
dialogues.text: And there's another girl lying down on the floor.

dialogues.jp:
暗闇の中に、均整の取れた身体を白くぼんやり
と浮かび上がらせている。
dialogues.en: (Who is she......?)
dialogues.text: (Who is she......?)

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんはまるで彫刻のようだった。
dialogues.en:
She looks like Yoriko-san, but a little different. And she's
wearing clothes.
dialogues.text:
She looks like Yoriko-san, but a little different. And she's
wearing clothes.

dialogues.jp:
生気が感じられない。表情も身体も、微動だに
しない。息をしているのかさえ、分からない。
dialogues.en: (Oh, is she Misaki?)
dialogues.text: (Oh, is she Misaki?)

dialogues.jp: そして床には、一人の少女が横たわっていた。
dialogues.en:
The girl has both hands on her chest with her eyes gently
closed. Misaki looks just like a dead person.
dialogues.text:
The girl has both hands on her chest with her eyes gently
closed. Misaki looks just like a dead person.

dialogues.en:
But her chest is moving slightly up and down, showing that
she's alive.
dialogues.text:
But her chest is moving slightly up and down, showing that
she's alive.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんによく似ているが、どことなく違うよ
うだ。
dialogues.en: (What's going on here......?)
dialogues.text: (What's going on here......?)

dialogues.jp: （あ、これが……例の、美咲、か？）
dialogues.en: Of course this is not my dream. I am in Yoriko-san's dream.
dialogues.text: Of course this is not my dream. I am in Yoriko-san's dream.

dialogues.jp:
胸の前で手を組み、両目は穏やかに閉じられて
いて、美咲はまるで死者のようだった。
dialogues.en:
Then the statue -- Yoriko-san moves. She walks near the wall
and slides the door open.
dialogues.text:
Then the statue -- Yoriko-san moves. She walks near the wall
and slides the door open.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、ゆるやかな胸の上下が、美咲がきちん
と生きていることを示している。
dialogues.en: It's a closet, with many clothes on hangers.
dialogues.text: It's a closet, with many clothes on hangers.

dialogues.jp: （一体、何なんだ、このシーンは……）
dialogues.en: Yoriko-san stops moving again, with her back to me.
dialogues.text: Yoriko-san stops moving again, with her back to me.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、俺自身の夢ではない。頼子さんの夢
を見せられている。
dialogues.en: And just like that, a long time passes.
dialogues.text: And just like that, a long time passes.

dialogues.jp:
と、彫像が──頼子さんが動いた。壁際まで行
き、がらがらと戸を開く。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san shakes her head once, puts on only her underwear
and closes the closet.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san shakes her head once, puts on only her underwear
and closes the closet.

dialogues.jp:
中には、たくさんの服がハンガーで吊されてい
た。クローゼットだ。
dialogues.en: She walks out of the room.
dialogues.text: She walks out of the room.

dialogues.jp:
背中を向けたまま、頼子さんは、再び固まって
しまった。
dialogues.en: When she comes back, she's wearing the maid costume.
dialogues.text: When she comes back, she's wearing the maid costume.

dialogues.jp: そのまま、長い時間が過ぎた。
dialogues.en: There's the familiar Yoriko-san standing there.
dialogues.text: There's the familiar Yoriko-san standing there.

dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 夢をみた。
dialogues.en: I was in my math class, but all of a sudden I'm outside.
dialogues.text: I was in my math class, but all of a sudden I'm outside.

dialogues.jp: そこは夢でみた、あの部屋だった。
dialogues.en: "...... Am I dreaming?"
dialogues.text: "...... Am I dreaming?"

dialogues.jp:
そこには頼子さんがいた。無表情なその顔はま
るで彫刻のようだった。
dialogues.en:
The math class always makes me sleepy so I'm not surprised
if it's really happening.
dialogues.text:
The math class always makes me sleepy so I'm not surprised
if it's really happening.

dialogues.jp:
足元の床には横たわる少女……これが『美咲』
なのだろうか？
dialogues.en: (But where am I anyway......?)
dialogues.text: (But where am I anyway......?)

dialogues.jp:
やがて頼子さんは部屋を出て行くといつものメ
イド服を身につけて戻ってきた。
dialogues.en:
It looks like I'm in a room, but I don't know whose room it
is. It's dark and seems like it's late at night.
dialogues.text:
It looks like I'm in a room, but I don't know whose room it
is. It's dark and seems like it's late at night.

dialogues.jp: 見慣れた頼子さんがそこにいた。
dialogues.en:
I think I've seen this room before. Where did I see it and
when......?
dialogues.text:
I think I've seen this room before. Where did I see it and
when......?
